registrar-api_domain_name.description:
Provides a fully qualified domain name (FQDN), including the extension
(e.g., `example.com`, `mybrand.app`). The domain name uniquely identifies
a registration. Cloudflare permits only one registration per domain, making
the domain name a natural idempotency key for registration requests.

registrar-api_registration.description: A domain registration resource representing the current state of a registered domain.

auto_renew.description: Whether automatic renewal occurs before expiration.

created_at.description: When the domain was registered. Present when the registration resource exists.

expires_at.description: When the domain registration expires. Ready registrations include this value; only `registration_pending` and `transfer_pending` may return null.

locked.description: Whether the domain is locked for transfer.

privacy_mode.description: Current WHOIS privacy mode for the registration.

status.description:
Current registration status.
- `active`: The domain operates with an active registration.
- `registration_pending`: Registration remains in progress.
- `transfer_pending`: Domain transfer is in progress.
- `expired`: The domain registration expired.
- `suspended`: The registry suspended the domain.
- `redemption_period`: The domain entered the redemption grace period.
- `pending_delete`: The registry scheduled the domain for deletion.
